g.text: $ cloud test suite, analytics endpoint stage
== analytics endpoint against local Postgres (migrated schema, row-level security)
✔ FR-P04: wrong method -> 405 and nothing is read
✔ NFR-06: missing or forged token -> 401 before any data access
✔ openapi /analytics: window must be exactly 30 or 90 -> 400 bad_request, no data access
✔ FR-P04: a free user gets 403 premium_required and NO plant or reading is read
✔ 500: a failed premium check, plant read or reading read -> 'internal', no database detail in the body
✔ NFR-07-style paging: reads every page until an empty one; the offset advances by the rows actually returned (a server row cap cannot skip rows)
✔ setup: three users, two premium and one free; each has its own plants and readings
✔ FR-P04: the free user is refused 403 premium_required (integration, real is_premium())
✔ FR-P01: premium user, window=30 -> 200 with the openapi shape, hand-computed aggregates for Basil and zeros for Aloe
✔ FR-P01: window=90 -> the same readings; the first week is empty so the trend is null
✔ NFR-06: the answer names only the caller's plants; F's plant and readings never appear
✔ paging over the real database: 2,401 rows in three pages (1000, 1000, 401) and one empty page
✔ 500 on a database failure as the user (a table that does not exist), no database text in the body
